content.text: Give the firm a persistable register of natural persons — individual people, as distinct from the legal-entity counterparties it already models — realising the CDM type
, so person data is carried in CDM shape from the first row. Everything else in this spec is intentionally minimal: the entity, its sub-structure, and the platform's standard screens.

beans and CDM's multi-valued name parts and emails kept as lists; CDM's
list flattened to a single text field per the author's decision.
The platform's standard screens for the entity (search, view, edit).
